title: Binance Adds API3/BNB, BETA/ETH, INJ/TRY & TLM/BNB Trading Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will open trading for API3/BNB, BETA/ETH, INJ/TRY and TLM/BNB trading pairs at 2022-02-25 09:00 AM (UTC). Please note: TRY is a fiat currency and does not represent any other digital currencies. Risk warning : Cryptocurrency trading is subject to high market risk. Please make your trades cautiously.
